entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return. Order number is 774-B-91. Just tell me if I can do it.
Hello, you've reached Isaac at VeloFit. I can certainly look into that return for you. One moment while I pull up that order.
Alright, I see the order from 70 days ago for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's just the wrong color. It was a gift, the box is still unopened. It's been sitting in my closet.
I understand. Getting the right gear that you'll actually use is critical for safety. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item.
Is it a yes or a no?

It's a yes. That helmet falls under our 90-day return window, so you're well within the timeframe. Since the box is unopened, the process will be very simple. I am generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email on your account right now.
Okay, perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good one.
